visual.description: Full-width black hero with left text block (~25%), center floating UI panel (~20%), and right large 3D object (~30%), with significant negative space between columns.
Full-width section with a centered heading above a horizontal row of 5 equal-width cards showing user-generated content with avatar and tool label overlays.
Continuation of community gallery with cards scrolled to reveal different items, same 5-column equal-width structure with a 'Start for free' CTA centered below.
Left side (~55%) contains a stacked UI mockup with a floating 3D figure, right side (~45%) has a vertically stacked accordion list of feature names with +/- toggles separated by horizontal rules.
Same 2-column split as above, continuing the accordion feature list with additional items below the fold.
Centered heading 'Created with Endless Tools' above a wide multi-row masonry-style gallery of varied-width cards that overflow the viewport horizontally.
Full-width section with centered heading 'About Tools on X' and a 3-column grid of Twitter/X post cards at equal widths, with a horizontal image strip above.
Centered heading above 3 equal-width pricing tier cards (Free, Creator, Master) in a horizontal row with feature lists and CTA buttons inside each card.
Full-width rounded-corner gradient image banner with centered text and a single 'Contact sales' button overlaid on top.
Centered single-column layout with a large heading, email input field, subscribe button, and privacy checkbox stacked vertically.
Simple centered footer with two rows of inline text links and a copyright line, no column grid structure.
